universal_patterns.pattern: boards and commissions listed in AS 08\.01\.010

trigger_patterns: following boards have the termination date
proposal.rationale: Refinements: Most of the chapter-02 undetermined sections are genuinely profession-specific (geologist certification, euthanasia permits, telehealth for health-care providers only, out-of-state multidisciplinary team sanctions, mental-health disclosure carve-outs) and should remain undetermined rather than being force-classified as universal. Section 08.02.110 ("Professional designation requirements") enumerates many practice acts via "X licensed under AS 08.YY" — added a broader trigger pattern "licensed in (this|the) state as a ... under" to catch the chiropractor-style phrasing. Section 08.03.010 enumerates termination dates for all the listed boards — added "following boards have the termination date" as a trigger so the AS 08.YY citations get enumerated. The chapter-02 limitation-of-liability section refers only to specific committees and is not universal. Kept chapter-level universal patterns narrow to avoid over-classifying chapter-02 miscellaneous provisions.
